fields.name: ZoomInput
fields.evidence: Not replicated. Toolkit GameEngine.dll: operator= (+0x264710) copies 4,4,4,4,4 bytes, 1 byte at +0x14, then 4,4,4 - widths of every member. Constructor (+0x7D52A0) sets 0; Reset (+0x7D52E0) zeroes +0..+0xB. ls::CameraSystem::OnInputArcBallCameraBehavior writes input events 0x1B/0x1C (zoom in/out) here; UpdateArcBallCameraBehavior multiplies it by ZoomSpeed and adds it to Distance.

fields.name: YawInput
fields.evidence: OnInput writes events 0x21/0x22 (only while the mouse flag at +0x14 is set); Update multiplies it by RotationSpeed (+0xC), converts degrees to radians (0.017453292) and adds it to the angle at +0x20.

fields.name: PitchInput
fields.evidence: OnInput writes events 0x23/0x24 (only with the mouse flag); Update multiplies by RotationSpeed, converts to radians and adds to the angle at +0x1C.

fields.name: RotationSpeed
fields.evidence: Constructor 0x3E800000 (0.25); multiplies both rotation inputs in UpdateArcBallCameraBehavior.

fields.name: RotateActive
fields.evidence: Constructor 0; OnInput event 1 stores the input value's button byte here; rotation inputs are accepted only when it is non-zero (mouse button held).

fields.name: Distance
fields.evidence: Constructor 0x3EB33333 (0.35); Update adds the scaled zoom input and uses it as the radius of the spherical-coordinate eye offset.

fields.name: Pitch
fields.evidence: Constructor 0x3FB0DBE6 (1.3817 rad); Update clamps it to 0.1..3.0415928 and uses sin/cos of it as the polar angle.

fields.name: Yaw
fields.evidence: Constructor 0x4096DED8 (4.714 rad); Update uses cos/sin of it as the azimuth.

open_questions: Client-only; registry totalSize 36 on the client row only. Offsets and widths from the Toolkit (GameEngine.dll) class code; macOS default constructor agrees (q0 at +0, w at +0x10, byte at +0x14, d at +0x18, w at +0x20). Names inferred from the camera maths.
